protocol_summary: Four raters annotate raw T2w images with dorsal C2–T1 rootlet labels; numeric value 2 denotes C2 and subsequent levels are sequential. No preprocessing is applied.
scope_conflict: Snapshot sidecars still describe C2–C8, while original issue specifies C2–T1 and arrays contain label 9. Class 9 is retained as T1 with this source evidence.

license_evidence.handling: Retain attribution and CC BY 4.0 notices; do not describe the data as unambiguously public domain.

context_mask_provenance.cord: Algorithm-generated, not relabelled as manual ground truth.
context_mask_provenance.disc_labels: Manual single-voxel landmarks, not segmented discs.
